name: What types of services are typically included in restoration maintenance plans?

mainEntity.name: What types of services are typically included in restoration maintenance plans?

acceptedAnswer.text: Restoration maintenance plans can vary but commonly include a range of services designed to keep your property in top condition. These often cover exterior inspections for roofing, siding, and foundations, as well as interior checks for plumbing, electrical systems, and structural elements. Services may also include repainting, sealing, cleaning of specific materials, and minor repairs to prevent degradation. The exact scope is customized to the specific restoration work performed and the property's needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance plans typically include exterior and interior inspections, minor repairs, cleaning, and material upkeep. Services are customized based on the restoration work and property needs.
